svg.title: The Trial
svg.desc: A ring of twenty-three beads round a balance. Six gold beads sit on one open beam and eight on the next. The last nine are empty sockets shut inside a walled chamber with no door. In the middle a balance holds three rods of three, five and six beads: three and five in the left pan, six in the right, and the beam tips a little to the left. Under the balance stand two rings and one bead.
